s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic unilateral eyelid swelling with purulent discharge
salient_findings: 2-year history of swelling of the right upper eyelid
Purulent discharge for 10 months
Immovable scarlike node on the right upper eyelid
Ring enhancement in the right frontal sinus on MRI
Opacification of the right frontal, ethmoid, and maxillary sinuses on CT
key_facts: 52-year-old Japanese woman
2-year history of right upper eyelid swelling
10 months of purulent discharge
No history of trauma to the head
No symptoms of fever, headache, or nasal discharge
Immovable scarlike node on the right upper eyelid
Node measures 11 × 7 mm
MRI shows high signal on T2-weighted image and ring enhancement in the right frontal sinus
CT shows opacification of the right frontal, ethmoid, and maxillary sinuses
Expansion of the right frontal and ethmoid sinuses without bone destruction
Histopathology reveals mild inflammatory infiltrate with fibrosis and lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate

shortlist.label: Chronic dacryocystitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic unilateral eyelid swelling with purulent discharge, consistent with blockage of the nasolacrimal duct

shortlist.label: Frontal sinus mucocele
shortlist.why_kept: MRI and CT findings of opacification and expansion of the right frontal sinus, consistent with a mucocele

shortlist.label: Actinomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic purulent discharge and presence of an immovable scarlike node, consistent with actinomycotic infection

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Mild inflammatory infiltrate with fibrosis and lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate on histopathology, consistent with sarcoidosis

shortlist.label: Kimura disease
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic unilateral eyelid swelling and presence of eosinophils on histopathology, consistent with Kimura disease

trace.fact: 2-year history of swelling of the right upper eyelid

rule_in.why: it often presents with eyelid swelling

rule_out.why: it is compatible with all candidates

rule_in.why: it is most associated with long-standing purulent discharge

rule_out.why: Sarcoidosis does not typically present with purulent discharge

trace.fact: Immovable scarlike node on the right upper eyelid

rule_in.why: it is often associated with immovable scarlike nodes on the eyelids

trace.fact: Ring enhancement in the right frontal sinus on MRI

rule_in.why: it is most directly related to the frontal sinus
